name: Throh

attacks.name: Circle Throw
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent’s Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

flavor:
It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill.
Over the course of many battles, Throh’s belt
grows darker as it absorbs its wearer’s sweat.
